title: Tecsys TS8300 Digital Media Converter
excerpt: The TS8300 is a digital media converter with multiple inputs and outputs, and can receive, process and distribute various signal sources such as: digital audio and video in IP, ASI or TS protocol; digital data such as Closed Caption, EPG, cryptographic systems, remote switching and private tables, as well as operating as digital decoder, TS / BTS processor and data multiplexer with SDI, ASI and IP outputs
body:
The TS8300 is a digital media converter with multiple inputs and outputs, and can receive, process and distribute various signal sources such as: digital audio and video in IP, ASI or TS protocol; digital data such as Closed Caption, EPG, cryptographic systems, remote switching and private tables, as well as operating as digital decoder, TS / BTS processor and data multiplexer with SDI, ASI and IP outputs.

Main Features:

SD-MPEG-1,2,4 – 1.5 up to 15Mbps MP @ ML

HD-MPEG-2 – 4 to 50Mbps

Supports SD / HD H.264 formats

Supports MPEG2 SD / HD

Audio Embedded in HD-SDI / SD-SDI

Resolution: Displays most HD & SD video formats: 480i, 480p 720p 1080i (up to 1920 x 1240)

1x Gigabit Ethernet Port (GbE)

Flexible routing of inputs / outputs, CAM slots and converters
